name: advent
title: Advent
description: A Christmas-market theme whose programme is a printed advent calendar — little doors in three widths, cut in gilt on three sides and hinged on the fourth, each numbered and with its time in gilt slab figures in the corner — on a night-green card dusted with snow, laid on the night or on a snowed-in white morning.

tokens.--font-slab: the slab-serif capitals and figures: the event's name, headings, menu title, door titles and times, day headings, dates and buttons
tokens.--font-sans: the humanist sans of running text, the menu links, places, notes and the facts
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the slab capitals in names, headings, door titles and buttons
tokens.--tracking-label: wider letter spacing of the small gilt labels: the date, the programme and people headings, the line under the masthead and post dates
tokens.--color-bg: page background around the calendar card (night in the dark scheme, a snowed-in white morning in the light one), and the text of selected words
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings and the menu on the page around the card
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: notes on doors, addresses, notes about people, post summaries, the intro under a page title, the footer; also the underline of a hovered menu link
tokens.--color-gilt: gilt print on the page around the card: the current-menu underline, post dates, the double rules above the reply block, the posts and the footer, list markers, table headings and the highlight behind selected text
tokens.--color-hinge: the dashed fold along each door's hinged left side
tokens.--color-door: the face of a door, a shade off the card
tokens.--color-rule: thin dividing lines on the page: under the masthead, between people, between posts and in tables; also the shade that shows a wide table scrolls
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--color-card: the calendar card: night-green board in both schemes, behind the invitation on the home page, the programme and the 404
tokens.--color-card-text: type on the card: the event's name, the invitation line, day headings and door titles
tokens.--color-card-muted: secondary type on the card: notes on doors and the address
tokens.--color-card-accent: links, buttons and focus rings on the card (gilt)
tokens.--color-card-accent-ink: text on a button on the card
tokens.--color-card-gilt: gilt print on the card: the double-rule frame, the three cut edges and knob of every door, door numbers and times, stars, places, day lozenges, the date and the rule beside the facts
tokens.--color-card-snow: the faint snow dusted over the card
tokens.--measure: width of the text column on pages and posts
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the masthead, the calendar and the footer grow
tokens.--door-min: the shortest a door is cut; a door with more words grows, and so does the rest of its row
tokens.--door-gap: the strip of card left between one door and the next
tokens.--door-figure: size of the gilt time figures in the top corner of every door (smaller on a phone)
tokens.--cut: weight of a door's cut edges and hinge fold, the ring round its number, the menu underline, and the rules beside the facts, beside quotations and under table headings
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of doors, buttons, code blocks and focus rings
tokens.--knob: diameter of the gilt knob on each door's opening edge
tokens.--double: thickness of the gilt double rules above the calendar, the reply block, the posts and the footer, and of a dividing rule in page text
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: between the lines of a fact
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under labels and between buttons
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the footer
